prompt: Create an original 60 second fingerstyle acoustic folk instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: steel-string guitar, mandolin, light hand percussion. Style: alternating bass picking and a clear acoustic melody. Tempo approximately 84 BPM; D major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A calm and mellow acoustic guitar piece with a gentle bass line, creating a relaxing and pleasant atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首平静而柔和的木吉他曲，配以轻柔的贝斯线，营造出轻松愉悦的氛围。
